objective: Learners calculate how many weeks a fictional saver needs to reach a savings goal at a fixed weekly deposit, then recalculate the timeline after a fictional one-time deposit changes, so they can see how a lump-sum contribution shortens a savings goal.
scenario: This is a fictional, simulated scenario with no real account involved: a made-up seventh grader named Theo wants to save $84.00 for a simulated goal, depositing $6.00 of simulated money every week with no withdrawals.
materials: the fictional savings scenario on this task sheet

tasks.directions: Theo saves $6.00 of simulated money every week toward the $84.00 simulated goal, starting from $0.00.

prompts.text: How many weeks will it take Theo to reach exactly $84.00?

tasks.directions: After week 4, Theo receives a fictional $24.00 gift and deposits all of it into the same simulated savings goal on top of the regular weekly deposits.

prompts.text: How much has Theo saved in total right after that week-4 deposit, including the $24.00 gift?
How much more does Theo still need to save to reach the full $84.00 goal after that point?

tasks.directions: Continuing at $6.00 per week after week 4 with the gift already included.

prompts.text: How many additional weeks, after week 4, does Theo need to finish reaching the $84.00 goal?
In total, counting from week 1, in which week number does Theo reach the goal?

tasks.directions: Compare the original plan to the plan with the gift.

prompts.text: Explain how many weeks the gift saved Theo compared to the original plan without it, and why a one-time lump sum has that effect on a savings timeline.

remediation: If a learner divides incorrectly or loses track of the running total, reteach with a week-by-week table listing the running total after each deposit, filling it in one row at a time until it reaches or passes the goal.
extension: Have the learner design their own fictional savings goal and weekly deposit amount, calculate the weeks needed, then add their own fictional mid-plan lump sum and recalculate the new timeline.
